", "calendar_core/slots.py": """"Tiny day-planning helpers. Times are minutes after midnight (0-1440).

Rules (the contract every change must keep):

* An Event covers the half-open interval [start, end): it includes its start
  minute and excludes its end minute. start < end is required.
* Two events overlap only if they share at least one minute. Back-to-back
  events (one ends exactly when the next starts) do not overlap.
* free_slots(events, day_start, day_end, min_minutes) returns the gaps inside
  [day_start, day_end) not covered by any event, as (start, end) tuples sorted
  by start. Events may arrive in any order and may overlap each other. Only
  gaps of at least min_minutes are returned. Events partly outside the day
  are clipped to it.
* find_meeting_time(calendars, duration, day_start, day_end) returns the
  earliest (start, start + duration) inside [day_start, day_end) where nobody
  in any calendar has an event, or None if there is no such time. Events are
  half-open and partly-outside events are clipped. duration must be a
  positive integer, otherwise ValueError is raised.
* parse_time turns "HH:MM" (24-hour) or 12-hour times like "9am" and
  "2:30pm" into minutes. Anything it cannot parse raises ValueError.
* parse_event parses "<start>-<end> <title>" into an Event. Start and end
  accept anything parse_time accepts, spaces around "-" are allowed, and
  the title (possibly empty) is the rest of the text stripped of surrounding
  spaces. A missing dash, an invalid time, or an end not after the start
  raises ValueError.
* fmt_duration(minutes) renders "Xh YYm" (e.g. 65 -> "1h 05m", 45 -> "0h 45m").
* day_summary(events, day_start, day_end) returns
  "<N> events | busy <D1> | longest free <D2>" ("1 event" when N is 1),
  where N counts events overlapping [day_start, day_end), D1 is the time
  inside the day covered by at least one event, and D2 is the longest free
  gap inside the day, both formatted with fmt_duration.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import re
from dataclasses import dataclass

MINUTES_PER_DAY = 1440


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Event:
    start: int
    end: int
    title: str = ""

    def __post_init__(self):
        if not (0 <= self.start < self.end <= MINUTES_PER_DAY):
            raise ValueError(f"bad event times {self.start}-{self.end}")


def parse_time(text: str) -> int:
    """Parse "HH:MM" (24-hour) or a 12-hour time like "9am"/"2:30pm" into minutes after midnight."""
    if not isinstance(text, str):
        raise ValueError(f"bad time {text!r}")
    stripped = text.strip()
    match = re.fullmatch(r"(\d{1,2})(?::(\d{1,2}))?\s*(am|pm)", stripped, re.IGNORECASE)
    if match:
        h = int(match.group(1))
        m = int(match.group(2)) if match.group(2) is not None else 0
        if not (1 <= h <= 12 and 0 <= m < 60):
            raise ValueError(f"bad time {text!r}")
        h = h % 12 + (12 if match.group(3).lower() == "pm" else 0)
        return h * 60 + m
    if stripped.lower().endswith(("am", "pm")):
        raise ValueError(f"bad time {text!r}")
    hours, minutes = stripped.split(":")
    h, m = int(hours), int(minutes)
    if not (0 <= h < 24 and 0 <= m < 60):
        raise ValueError(f"bad time {text!r}")
    return h * 60 + m


def parse_event(text: str) -> Event:
    """Parse "<start>-<end> <title>" into an Event."""
    if not isinstance(text, str):
        raise ValueError(f"bad event {text!r}")
    if "-" not in text:
        raise ValueError(f"bad event {text!r}")
    start_text, rest = text.split("-", 1)
    start = parse_time(start_text)
    stripped_rest = rest.strip()
    if not stripped_rest:
        raise ValueError(f"bad event {text!r}")
    tokens = list(re.finditer(r"\S+", stripped_rest))
    # A 12-hour end time may be split as e.g. "2:30 pm", so include a
    # following am/pm token as part of the end time rather than the title.
    end_token_count = 2 if len(tokens) > 1 and tokens[1].group().lower() in ("am", "pm") else 1
    end_end = tokens[end_token_count - 1].end()
    end = parse_time(stripped_rest[tokens[0].start():end_end])
    title = stripped_rest[end_end:].strip()
    return Event(start, end, title)


def overlaps(a: Event, b: Event) -> bool:
    """True if the two events share at least one minute."""
    return a.start < b.end and b.start < a.end


def free_slots(events: list[Event], day_start: int, day_end: int, min_minutes: int = 1) -> list[tuple[int, int]]:
    """Gaps of at least min_minutes inside [day_start, day_end) not covered by any event."""
    clipped = []
    for ev in events:
        start = max(ev.start, day_start)
        end = min(ev.end, day_end)
        if start < end:
            clipped.append((start, end))
    clipped.sort()
    slots = []
    cursor = day_start
    for start, end in clipped:
        if start > cursor:
            slots.append((cursor, start))
        if end > cursor:
            cursor = end
    if cursor < day_end:
        slots.append((cursor, day_end))
    return [(s, e) for s, e in slots if e - s >= min_minutes]


def find_meeting_time(calendars: list[list[Event]], duration: int, day_start: int, day_end: int) -> tuple[int, int] | None:
    """Earliest (start, start + duration) inside [day_start, day_end) free in every calendar, or None."""
    if isinstance(duration, bool) or not isinstance(duration, int) or duration <= 0:
        raise ValueError(f"bad duration {duration!r}")
    all_events = [event for calendar in calendars for event in calendar]
    slots = free_slots(all_events, day_start, day_end, min_minutes=duration)
    if not slots:
        return None
    start = slots[0][0]
    return (start, start + duration)


def fmt_duration(minutes: int) -> str:
    """Render minutes as "Xh YYm"."""
    return f"{minutes // 60}h {minutes % 60:02d}m"


def day_summary(events: list[Event], day_start: int, day_end: int) -> str:
    """One-line summary: "<N> events | busy <D1> | longest free <D2>" for [day_start, day_end)."""
    count = sum(1 for ev in events if max(ev.start, day_start) < min(ev.end, day_end))
    slots = free_slots(events, day_start, day_end, min_minutes=1)
    free_total = sum(end - start for start, end in slots)
    busy = max(day_end - day_start, 0) - free_total
    longest_free = max((end - start for start, end in slots), default=0)
    label = "1 event" if count == 1 else f"{count} events"
    return f"{label} | busy {fmt_duration(busy)} | longest free {fmt_duration(longest_free)}"
